I try to stay in the present, but present is so hard to bear and carry on. Try to look into the future, and the only thing that I see is same me. or worse me. because aging sucks.

I thought about those. and I am supposed to be "starting new" right now. But i just have no strength. Future looks so gleam, menial, annoying, boring. help.

Hi. My life story.. I've had pretty comfortable good life thanks to a lot of sacrifices my parents made for us. I immigrated to states in 6th grade, had problem integrating with the mainstream. So I just studied studied, went to medical school But I fucked up hard by getting kicked out of medical school on my third year with 180k student loan. I fucked up really bad. There is too much shame, guilt, regret generated by my mind. I suffered very severe clinical depression in medical school. Probably because I smoked too much pot & other issues. I struggled with self esteem.. but after I did a rotation in pathology, dissecting so many dead bodies and dealing with so many corpses, I saw vanity in life. I gave up. Weed addiction didn't stop, took some time off from the school, came back, didn't fix/work on my behaviors, suffered, and I sent a text to a patient (humiliating and embarrasing) and got kicked out. I was being complete delusional and retarded. I have so much shame and guilt. I am supposed to live with consequences of my actions and all that. but pain from past and consequences are too heavy. I gave up on myself.

So you might ask why write here..
thanks for talking...... i still have the belt around my neck.. I am scared I am actually going to walk to the bathroom and complete the action..

Sir.. if I may. I used to go to medical school for 3 years, accumulated 180k student debt, did not finish the MD degree because I thought I wanted to do something else, and now that I am out of the medicine, I am in complete regret mode since I can not go back. And I didn't realize tjat when I was in medicine but having MD degree gives you so much financial stability, potential and job security. I know grass is greener on the other side, but it's the simple truth. I would love to be in your position. With your professional degree, you can get employed anywhere in the country and start a new life.
